comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"6a8e9cf4aea38becd1a0b203c3e55d84fa04bd288e948a26defdcc4d4bf7561c"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — No filter rule is responsible:⁠ on speed.cloudflare.com the baseline applied no blocking or hiding rule (only one turnstile script exception and four Tracking Protection scriptlets), and the reported "ICE error" belongs to the site's WebRTC/TURN packet-loss step (turn.cloudflare.com:⁠3478, creds from /turn-creds), which HTTP filter lists never touch — the reporter's own comparison isolates it to the SOCKFILTER driver mode. The test could not be started in the locked session because Cloudflare's Turnstile start gate never unlocked in headless Chromium, so this is analysis-only with no rule proposal.

## Missing information

- search_rules urlPattern matching returns no matches for rules that exist: search_rules with urlPattern returned totalMatches:⁠0 for patterns whose rules I know are present, e.g. urlPattern "app.qualified.com" and "||app.qualified.com/*/messenger?$domain=cloudflare.com" (that exact rule is listed by a domain search at AnnoyancesFilter/Widgets/sections/widgets.txt:⁠2109), and also "challenges.cloudflare.com" and "turn.cloudflare.com". Only domain queries returned results. This leaves no way to inventory network rules by URL pattern or host, so duplicate/culprit checking for network rules must fall back to domain inventories and get_applied_rules.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40425705133

<sub>Automated analysis against filters at `74d6af9`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.</sub>
